owned_session_identity.note: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: thread/start returns a stable thread id reused by every later request, notification and resume

observed_cancellation.note: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: turn/interrupt ended a running shell loop and the receipt reports 'observed' only after turn/completed with status interrupted; shutdown escalates SIGTERM then SIGKILL against the owned process group and reports the observed group state

resume_session.note: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: a thread was resumed by id in a second app-server process after the first was terminated and answered from the earlier turn's history. Resuming a thread with no completed turn fails with -32600 'no rollout found'

active_turn_delivery.note: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: turn/steer with expectedTurnId accepted mid-turn, receipt state submitted_to_active_turn; a delivery with no active turn is queued and flushed into the next turn/start input

mcp_config_injection.note: MCP servers are configured through `-c mcp_servers...`

sandbox_workspace_write.note: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts (FR042 boundary): workspace-write with explicit writableRoots plus excludeSlashTmp and excludeTmpdirEnvVar. Writes inside the granted root succeed; writes to a sibling workspace, /tmp and $TMPDIR are denied with 'Operation not permitted'; network denied. Checked through command/exec and through a model-driven turn. Codex's own workspaceWrite default leaves /tmp and $TMPDIR writable, so both exclusions are always set by this adapter
